title: Reduced flat base change on alteration objects, products and generators
statement: Let $S,S'$ be reduced Noetherian schemes [def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $h:S'\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and assume each fibre stays reduced after every finite extension of its residue field. Fix a prime $\ell$. Use the category $\operatorname{alt}/S$ and the two classes of generating families from [def-per-prime-to-ell-alteration-topology]. Then ordinary scheme base change $F(T)=T\times_S S'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is an object of $\operatorname{alt}/S'$ for every object $T$ of $\operatorname{alt}/S$, and gives a functor on their morphisms. This functor preserves the terminal object and categorical fibre products: the image of any universal fibre-product cone in $\operatorname{alt}/S$ is a universal fibre-product cone in $\operatorname{alt}/S'$. The categorical fibre product here is the reduced union of the irreducible components of the ordinary product that dominate components of the base, rather than in general the whole ordinary product. Moreover $F$ sends every $\ell'$-decomposed etale generating family to a $\ell'$-decomposed etale family, and every proper surjective maximally $\ell'$-finite generating morphism to a proper surjective maximally $\ell'$-finite morphism. These assertions concern the generators, without assuming regularity of $T$ or asserting a normal crossings conclusion.
